message:
feat: extend geometry typing and spatial support (#24136)

This PR completes the current `#23913` geometry delivery across parser/catalog metadata, runtime typing, frontend display, SQL-visible geometry behavior, SRID enforcement, and spatial index support.

- add typed geometry DDL / metadata / protocol support for `POINT`, `GEOMETRY`, `LINESTRING`, `POLYGON`, `MULTIPOINT`, `MULTILINESTRING`, `MULTIPOLYGON`, and `GEOMETRYCOLLECTION`
- extend SQL-visible geometry round-trip, measurement, relation, and validation behavior, including subtype checks, malformed payload rejection, finite-coordinate enforcement, SRID syntax / metadata / mismatch enforcement, and mixed-SRID runtime checks
- wire `SPATIAL INDEX` creation / maintenance / planner paths so `SHOW CREATE TABLE`, `SHOW INDEX`, and indexed `EXPLAIN` paths work for validated predicates such as `ST_DISTANCE` and `ST_Contains`
- sync `SHOW` / `information_schema` golden files to the delivered geometry metadata behavior

Validation:
- `make build`
- `make ut`
- direct MySQL replay of the issue `#23913` SQL matrix on `127.0.0.1:6001`, including typed DDL, requested `ST_*`, SRID success/mismatch, `SHOW CREATE TABLE`, `SHOW INDEX`, and indexed `EXPLAIN` for `ST_DISTANCE(... ) <= const` and `ST_Contains(indexed_geom, const_geom)`
- `cd /Users/moukeyu/mo-tester && ./run.sh -n -g -p /Users/moukeyu/matrixone/test/distributed/cases/dml/show/show.test`
- `[SUMMARY] COST : 4s, TOTAL :189, SUCCESS : 189, FAILED :0, IGNORED :0, ABNORAML :0, SUCCESS RATE : 100%`
- `cd /Users/moukeyu/mo-tester && ./run.sh -n -g -p /Users/moukeyu/matrixone/test/distributed/cases/zz_accesscontrol/account_restricted.sql`
